# Getting help with Skykeep

Thanks for using Skykeep. Here's the quickest way to an answer.

## Start here

- **Read the [FAQ](../README.md#faq).** It covers sign-in, Advanced Data Protection, offline use, sync timing, and what's included.
- **Advanced Data Protection on?** Turn on **Access iCloud Data on the Web** on your iPhone: Settings → your name → iCloud → Access iCloud Data on the Web. Without it, Apple lets no app outside your devices read your iCloud data.
- **Can't stay signed in on Linux?** Make sure a Secret Service keyring is running (GNOME Keyring or KWallet) and `libsecret` is installed.

## Ask a question

Use **[Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep/discussions/categories/q-a)** for how-to questions, setup help, and anything you're unsure about. Answers there help the next person too.

## Report a bug

Open a **[bug report](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)**. Include your version, platform, how you installed Skykeep, and logs (the form shows how to get them). Please remove anything personal first.

## Suggest a feature

Share it in **[Discussions → Ideas](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep/discussions/categories/ideas)**, or open a **[feature request](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)** if it's concrete.

## Security

Never post security problems publicly. Use **[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep/security/advisories/new)**; see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## A note on Apple support

Skykeep is an independent project and isn't affiliated with Apple, so Apple Support can't help with Skykeep itself. For problems with your Apple Account or iCloud in general, Apple Support is the right place.

Skykeep is maintained by one person in their own time. Every report is read, and a clear, kind report is the fastest way to a fix.
